At least one of your parents is an Elf descendant of the Mark of Shadow bloodline, whether or not they manifested a mark. You gain the Dragonmarked Heritage trait. In addition, you can pick elf, Dragonmarked Heritage, and Mark of Shadow feats whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

As a member of the Mark of Shadow, you may utilise the following focus spells. Some of these spells may belong to a class or archetype. If you select one of these focus spells, they lose the class and archetype traits if they have it, and gain the Dragonmark, and Mark of Shadow traits. The tradition of the spell becomes Arcane. Note that rarity is maintained, and uncommon spells should still be verified with your GM.
